name: Red Sea Global
note: Al-Ahli's front-of-shirt sponsor since 2023; from 2026-27 the shirt carries AMAALA, Red Sea Global's wellness destination brand. Tier proposed (serious) in the pull request; a maintainer sets it.

why.text: Red Sea Global, whose AMAALA brand is on the front of Al-Ahli's shirt, is wholly owned by Saudi Arabia's state fund, the Public Investment Fund. Saudi Arabia carried out a record 345 executions in 2024. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That's called sportswashing.
